steps.content:
December 24, N.F. 114
Live Broadcast
Election Night - Prime Ministerial Debate

As music fills the air, the final round of the debate officially begins. The venue is packed to capacity, teeming with numerous Eastside residents who have congregated to witness this momentous event.

The venue erupts into a storm of cheers and jeers the moment MK steps onto the stage — after all, he missed the second round due to a shooting incident. The host scrambles to regain control and restore order amidst the tumultuous reaction.

steps.speaker: Debate Host
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, both present in the venue and tuning in from home, welcome to the last debate leading up to the 22nd DisCity Election.

steps.speaker: Debate Host
steps.content: As we all know, Mr. Max King, who survived a shooting recently, has now returned to the election stage.

steps.speaker: Debate Host
steps.content: Mr. King, could you please tell us how you were feeling during that moment? Many have expressed deep concern for you.
Scattered snickers and jeers echo through the venue. Quite a few spectators direct thumbs-down gestures towards MK, as shouts of "Coward!" and "Deserter!" ripple through the crowd.
The reaction is more than mere mockery but psychological torture for the man standing on stage. Yet MK maintains his silence.
Then, in a measured voice, he begins to speak.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...Thinking back to that moment brings me great pain.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I was met with overwhelming resistance, and my naivete and recklessness were laid bare. I was deluding myself, believing that I could single-handedly challenge the century-old corruption deeply rooted in our city, charging ahead blindly without considering the repercussions.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: And in the end, it was the person I respected and relied on the most who paid the price for it all.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Those bullets marked my defeat. I was filled with regret and remorse, experiencing genuine pain for the first time in my life.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: But none of that really matters.

Days and nights of investigation, waves of anger and regret, hidden traps, unseen enemies, incomprehensible plays... With the loss of his strongest pillar of support, for the first time in his life, King finally sees his own insignificance.
And he realizes that his personal strength or weakness holds no significance to the city.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: My personal defeat means nothing in this battle. Even if I were completely crushed and unable to rise again, this battle would not end.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Because in this era, I am not the only one who yearns for change. The leader of the revolution should never be just one person.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Because your vision shines so bright... It has guided me through the darkest nights, and I want you to go even farther...

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Keep going... my young master... and stay gold.
He lifts his head.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: It's those who witness justice denied and the weak trampled. Countless people have seen their aspirations ground to dust while being repeatedly fed one notion—just surrender, 'cause only those above get to decide fate; just give up,'cause you're powerless to make any change.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: These are the voices of those in power, and they never lack mouthpieces—Councilor Cavendish and Stewart, they are prime examples.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Likewise, those who dwell in the shadow of power should have the right to choose their own voice.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: If we fail, we rise again. If one becomes corrupt, another can take their place. There will always be someone to carry on this mission.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Now, I put myself forward as your candidate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If it really holds the value you say... Then please win and prove yourself by making real changes.
He recalls something and breaks into a smile.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Someone once called me a "bullhead." Guess I’d better live up to the name.
The tension in the venue eases slightly as murmurs of approval rise from the crowd. Max King, attuned to this change, straightens his posture and continues his speech with this newfound support.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: This isn't about Max King, or any king. What I want for this city is to move forward, to embrace change, and to greet a new life. If you share the same desire, speak up. I will listen to every voice, and speak for EVERY one of you.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: —This is the one and only purpose of my return.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Thank you.
[CG 2]
As his speech concludes, he takes a deep bow. The hall falls into a profound silence... until the first camera flash pierces the stillness.

steps.speaker: Cheering Crowd
steps.content: ...Bravo!! Well said!!

steps.speaker: Cheering Crowd
steps.content: Bring the West District back! Revive our city! Make DisCity great again!

steps.speaker: Cheering Crowd
steps.content: MK! MK! MK—

The hall erupts with a surge of energy. While it's impossible to tell the true supporters from those swept up in the contagious excitement, one thing is certain—these are all signs welcoming his return, their enthusiasm both fervent and uplifting.
Caught off guard by the overwhelming response from the audience, the host momentarily loses control of the proceedings and turns awkwardly to the other candidate.

steps.speaker: Debate Host
steps.content: Ms. Cavendish, would you like to say something?

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I have nothing to say. There's no need to continue this debate. We shall end it here.
With a subtle smile playing on her lips, Bernadette takes a moment to study Max King's expression before gracefully turning to leave.
<i>Don't look so troubled, Max. You have done well and lived up to expectations.<i>
<i>Savor this moment.<i>

Pine switches off her TV at home. The televised debate has concluded, and significant strides have been made in the cabinet attack investigation. With less than two days remaining until the vote, she knows the outcome has already been sealed.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...Well, suppose that wraps up my task.

However... there's still half of the investigation findings yet to be delivered. Pine clutches these documents close to her chest, unsure what to do with them. Frustration etches across her face as she scratches her head.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Ugh! Forget it!! I'll just let them handle it!! If they can't even manage this, they're not cut out for anything bigger!!
As she turns to leave with her findings, she finds unexpected visitors at her door.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You're...?! Mmph—!
[A Few Minutes Later]
A few minutes later, Pine lies motionless on the floor, completely unconscious.
One of the "visitors" bends down to retrieve the photos from Pine's possession and considers for a moment before leaving behind another folder of documents.
This is what you would really want... little newshound.
